changes: Scoped vector projection admits its null-prototype column directory, unique key entries and batch descriptor before constructing output.
Projection results transfer from a local scope on success; errors release partial output while preserving parent/sibling allocations.
Iterate source, selected and projected names directly instead of constructing Object.keys/Object.entries arrays and a wildcard Set.
Preserve alias backing without a duplicate data charge; descriptor storage is now accounted.
Use null-prototype column directories in gather and concatenation, fixing __proto__ loss exposed by own-property projection lookup.

scenarios: Typed projection and CASE scratch succeed at the exact peak and reject one byte below.
Wildcard/explicit duplicate names and an overwritten alias incur one key-entry charge.
Missing selected column, missing expression column and budget failure release partial allocations without disposing sibling storage.
Aliases preserve physical shape/backing and remain valid with execution-stage ownership.
Real Parquet prototype-like names survive filtered owned projection; gather/concat regression verifies own column properties.

remaining: Other physical operator directories, vector wrapper headers and planning/runtime overhead still require allocation review.
Borrowed backing must remain pinned by its caller; descriptor admission does not claim ownership of external input buffers.
No total Worker heap or production-cloud memory guarantee follows from these checks.
